component.name: Topopaper
component.summary: A live topographic map as your wallpaper

description.p: Topopaper draws the world in contour lines on your Wayland desktop. The map drifts and breathes, and flies between the places you care about — from the whole globe down to a single ski lift.

ul.li: Search for any place on Earth and a map of it is built from open data
Every map zooms smoothly out to the globe
A clock with the local weather, night-side city lights and aurora
Several colour themes; frame rate drops on battery and when windows cover it

description.p: Topopaper needs a compositor with the wlr-layer-shell protocol, such as sway, Hyprland, niri, river, Wayfire or KDE Plasma. It does not run on GNOME Shell.
Runs on Windows 10 and 11 and on macOS, with installers for both.
First release as an installable app, with a settings window and a first-run welcome.
